candidate_labels: Inflammatory Myofibroblastic Tumor of the Retroperitoneum

Desmoid Tumor: Needle biopsy revealed tumor consisted of well-proliferated spindle cells rich in collagen fibers
CT scan with contrast enhancement showed tumor between iliocostalis and psoas muscles in retroperitoneal space
Peripheral part of tumor was enhanced, while central part was not on CT scan
Left paravertebral muscles around tumor showed atrophy
Medial margin of tumor was deformed by left transverse process of second lumbar spine
Central part of tumor was iso/low intensity in T1-weighted phase on MRI
